verification_level: FAST plus BATCH; three repairs (one authority NULL-dereference reproduction, one stack-buffer overflow bound, one failure-path secret cleansing). No STOP remains open after repair.
scope: Per-file contract audit of eight EVP units: the portable keymgmt export/import ownership helper, the MDC2/RIPEMD-160/SHA-3/SHA-1-2/Whirlpool legacy digest statics, the PKCS#5 v1.5 PBKDF1 wrapper, and the scrypt PBE wrapper. method_store.rs was skipped as the method-store/OSSL_METHOD_CONSTRUCT_METHOD registry boundary and remains queued; p5_scrypt.rs was substituted from the next stable queue slot.

files_not_run.reason: Method-store registry and OSSL_METHOD_CONSTRUCT_METHOD dispatch boundary (store locking, construct/reserve/unreserve callbacks, method cache). Deferred for a dedicated boundary audit; it remains in REMAINING-AUDIT.txt at the head of the queue.

defects.description: evp_keymgmt_util_export tested only pk and export_cb, read pk->keymgmt without a NULL test and forwarded it to evp_keymgmt_export, which dereferences (*keymgmt).export. A fresh or otherwise unassigned EVP_PKEY (keymgmt NULL) is a C-valid input to EVP_PKEY_export/EVP_PKEY_todata through EVP_PKEY_export's non-legacy arm, so the crate reproduced the authority's NULL dereference.
defects.fix: Refuse a NULL pk->keymgmt with 0 before the exporter is reached; documented as the AGENTS.md section 17 divergence (a C-valid untyped key must not produce UB).
defects.witness: evp::keymgmt_lib::tests::exporting_an_unassigned_key_is_refused_before_the_method_dereference (passes; the pre-fix code would fault at the method read).

defects.class: unbounded provider-controlled size written into a fixed stack buffer
defects.description: PKCS5_PBE_keyivgen_ex accepted any positive EVP_MD_get_size(md) and passed it as the output length of EVP_KDF_derive into md_tmp[EVP_MAX_MD_SIZE]. evp_md_cache_constants only bounds a fetched method's size by INT_MAX, so a provider reporting size > 64 overflows the 64-byte frame buffer. The authority has the same unchecked size.
defects.fix: Refuse mdsize > EVP_MAX_MD_SIZE before the derive; documented as the AGENTS.md section 17 divergence.
defects.witness: Code and compile review; no in-tree fixture builds a provider method reporting size > 64 (NOT_RUN for a runtime control).

defects.class: secret-bearing stack storage not cleansed on failure paths
defects.description: The authority cleanses md_tmp/key/iv only after a successful cipher initialisation. A failed EVP_KDF_derive or EVP_CipherInit_ex jumps to err: and leaves partial derived key material in the frame. The port reproduced that ordering.
defects.fix: finish_err now cleanses all three buffers before releasing kctx and the PBEPARAM decode on every failure return; this is the AGENTS.md section 5 deliberate divergence. finish_err's safety contract now names the three caller-owned extents.
defects.witness: Code and compile review; stack residue is not externally observable, so no runtime cleansing witness (NOT_RUN).

contracts_reused: Legacy EVP_MD static carrier contract (M55): EVP_ORIG_GLOBAL objects are refused by up_ref/free, ctx_size 0 is inert because the provider fetch replaces the method, and the NO_INIT legacy arm returns before any init/update/final callback
Provider callback and reentrancy contract: export/import callbacks may re-enter provider code, so pk->lock is released across the round trip and the cache is re-checked under the write lock
Operation-cache ownership contract: OwnedCacheElem owns one CRYPTO_malloc block until into_raw, and op_cache_free / the two failure sites are the only releases
OSSL_PARAM terminated-array and caller-owned output-buffer contract
RC-1 allocator seam: FILE and LINE coordinates preserved for CRYPTO_malloc/CRYPTO_free
PBES err-path cleansing pattern already established in p5_scrypt.rs (err_cleanup cleanses the derived key before decode release)
ASN.1 private descriptor transposition contract (PBEPARAM and SCRYPT_PARAMS item shape, offsets and free path)
residuals: keymgmt_lib.rs retains its provider round-trip and lock-order obligations; no concurrency runtime control was run in this batch.
M56-D2 has no runtime witness because no in-tree fixture constructs a digest method whose reported size exceeds EVP_MAX_MD_SIZE.
M56-D3's cleansing is review-verified only; stack residue is not observable through the public interface.
The five legacy digest files are carriers only: their callbacks are unreachable on the zero-ctx_size statics through the legacy arm, and the provider fetch either replaces them or refuses.
No constant-time claim is made for any unit in this batch; the PBES units have no secret-dependent comparison.
